statement.zh: 教科文将苏萨表述为自晚五千年纪 BCE 起连续叠压的城市定居土丘群，含行政、居住与宫殿遗存（UNESCO 1455）。
statement.en: UNESCO frames Susa as mounds with continuous superimposed urban settlement from the late 5th millennium BCE, including administrative, residential, and palatial remains (UNESCO 1455).
